name-omits-visible-label-text.why: Generic control name/label-in-name; TT tests this via 5.C/6.A/7.x, no isolated test in the 4.1.2 file.

name-present-but-not-descriptive-of-purp.why: Generic accessible-name quality on a control; TT tests this via 5.C/6.A/7.x, no isolated test in the 4.1.2 file.

wrong-role-valid-but-inappropriate.why: Generic control role; TT tests this via 5.C/6.A/7.x, no isolated role test in the 4.1.2 file.

stale-or-contradicting-state-value.why: Initial static state/value mismatch, not an auto-update; TT tests value via 5.C/6.A/7.x, not isolated here.

iframe-name-does-not-describe-content.why: Iframe accessible name must describe its content; this is exactly 12.D's pass condition.

multipart-field-subnames-ambiguous.why: Compound form-field sub-names; TT tests this via 5.C, no isolated test in the 4.1.2 file.
